verdict.line: You lose if you let him freely land Q (Siphoning Strike) stacks and get caught by his level 6-8 Wither into Spirit Fire combo; you win if you poke from outside 255 range and deny his stacking all lane.

brief.thesis: Gwen's Q (Snip Snip!, range 450) outranges Nasus's Q (Siphoning Strike, range 255), so you can poke and even contest last hits without ever entering his trade range. The whole lane is a race between his permanent Siphoning Strike stacking and your Q/E poke damage, decided by whether you deny his farm before his level 6-8 Wither plus Spirit Fire window hits.

theirWindow.when: Wither and Spirit Fire both off cooldown
theirWindow.what: At level 6+ he can land W (Wither) to slow your movement and attack speed, then drop E (Spirit Fire) under you for an armor-reducing burn zone. Don't extend trades or chase through this combo; disengage with E (Skip 'n Slash) immediately.

yourWindow.when: his Q (Siphoning Strike) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Walk into Q (Snip Snip!) range and snip him repeatedly; he has nothing in his kit that out-ranges your 450 cone when his Q is down, so this is free damage and passive procs.

start.why: sustains through early poke exchanges and funds mana for repeated Q (Snip Snip!) harass, run in 94.8% of games at 51.8% win rate

boots.why: magic penetration pushes your Q and R damage through his growing health pool faster, the 53.2% win rate pick at 42.9% over Plated Steelcaps

runes.keystoneWhy: stacks through repeated Q (Snip Snip!) pokes and E (Skip 'n Slash) on-hit windows, rewarding the extended trades this matchup produces

summoners.why: Ignite punishes his Soul Eater lifesteal sustain and secures kills during your level 3-5 poke window before his stacks snowball, the 53.2% win rate pick at 65.9% over Flash+Teleport

playing.title: Poke from 450 range, not 255
playing.detail: Q (Snip Snip!) outranges his Siphoning Strike by nearly 200 units. Walk up, snip, walk back before he can ever swing on you.

playing.title: Deny his Siphoning Strike last hits
playing.detail: Every kill with Q permanently raises his future Q damage. Contest cannon minions and low-health casters with your own Q poke when his Q is on cooldown.

playing.title: Stand in your own mist to poke safely
playing.detail: W (Hallowed Mist) means he can only hit you if he walks into the mist zone himself. Pop it before extended trades so his only answer is committing to melee range.

playing.title: Save E for his all-in, not for damage
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash's dash is your out when he lands Wither. Use it to create distance first; if you tag him on the way out the cooldown partially refunds.

playing.title: Back off during his 6-8 spike
playing.detail: Once he has Fury of the Sands, his Wither into Spirit Fire combo deals real damage and sustains him off Soul Eater. Don't trade through it, disengage and reset.

playing.title: Open with R from outside his kit entirely
playing.detail: Needlework's 1200 range clears every Nasus ability range (Q 255, E 650, W 700, R 400). From level 6 on, open trades with a needle before he can respond.

playing.title: Slow-push if you're losing the stack race
playing.detail: If he's out-stacking you despite your poke, build a slow push so his safe farming windows shrink and he's forced to either lose CS or walk up into your Q range.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample numbers are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the matchup reasoning and timing calls are my own tactical read, not from the data source.
